answer: Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the walnut of the next round.
